title: Fix tracking of routing permutation in Sabre with disjoint backends
your_notes: Sabre omitted unused disjoint coupling components when constructing the routing permutation, leaving final layout/permutation tracking incomplete.

title: Propagate DAGCircuit.name in ApplyLayout
your_notes: ApplyLayout produced an output DAG without propagating DAGCircuit.name metadata; this is pass-specific metadata propagation rather than a distinct representation conversion.

title: Fix composing virtual permutation layouts for ElidePermutations and StarPreRouting
your_notes: Permutation-layout composition used the wrong inverse/convention when combining virtual/final layouts across passes.

title: Fix deepcopy/pickle of DAGCircuit variable IO nodes
your_notes: A DAGCircuit pack/unpack typo changed Var output nodes into input nodes specifically during deepcopy or unpickling.

title: Fix ElidePermutations pass in the presence of PermutationGates
your_notes: ElidePermutations updated its internal qubit mapping incorrectly for PermutationGate patterns, corrupting output and virtual_permutation_layout.

title: Fix composition of final_layout
your_notes: final_layout composition used the routing permutation direction/convention backwards when composing layouts.

title: Fix VF2 layout allocation with idle qubits
your_notes: VF2 failed to allocate completely idle virtual qubits into its returned Layout; the fix completes the pass output rather than adding a validation check.

title: Fix TranspileLayout.initial_index_layout with unordered virtuals
your_notes: initial_index_layout incorrectly treated enumerate(dict.items()) insertion position as the virtual-qubit index; this is a wrong ordering assumption, not run-to-run nondeterminism.

title: Preserve registers through Python Layout to Rust TranspileLayout conversion
your_notes: The ApplyLayout Rust move explicitly dropped register metadata in Python Layout -> Rust TranspileLayout -> Python TranspileLayout conversion.

title: Fix HighLevelSynthesis for custom gate calibrations
your_notes: HLS failed to recognize custom gate calibrations when the calibrated gate appeared inside a nested instruction.

title: Fix alignment checks of stretch variables
your_notes: Scheduling alignment logic incorrectly applied alignment checks to stretch-based delays that are intended to be resolved by a lower-level compiler.

title: Fix HLS classical-bit mapping from control-flow blocks
your_notes: HLS used classical-bit indices local to the nested high-level block instead of remapping them to the corresponding global-circuit indices.

title: Fix ConsolidateBlocks qubit mapping inside control-flow blocks
your_notes: ConsolidateBlocks recursed into control-flow blocks without remapping block qubits back to hardware/global qubits.

title: Avoid panics in Optimize1qGatesDecomposition
your_notes: The Rust pass could panic when an input circuit had more qubits than the backend/target supported; the boundary/shape mismatch is now handled instead of panicking.

title: Check target gates are parameterized in optimize1qgatesdecomposition
your_notes: The pass trusted target gate names without checking that the target operation was parameterized and valid for synthesis; the fix adds that validation.

title: Fix TemplateOptimization dropping the global_phase on substitution
your_notes: TemplateOptimization failed to propagate and correctly accumulate global_phase through circuit-to-DAGDependency conversion and template substitution.

title: Fix ParameterVector global-phase panic in RemoveIdentityEquivalent
your_notes: RemoveIdentityEquivalent detached from Python and then cloned a ParameterVector-backed SymbolExpr during a global-phase update, causing a PyO3 refcount panic rather than an incorrect phase value.

title: Fix ConstrainedReschedule barrier handling
your_notes: Rust ConstrainedReschedule wrongly rejected barrier/directive operations instead of treating directives as unconstrained, contrary to the pass behavior.

title: Fix cache and prediction misses in Target::qargs
your_notes: Randomized Qargs hash-map iteration degraded graph edge locality, CPU-cache behavior, and branch prediction; this is a performance regression rather than semantic nondeterministic output.
